# Sweet Steps — Premium 3D Casting, Jaipur

> Sweet Steps is Jaipur's premium 3D hand-and-feet casting studio. We turn newborn, sibling, couple, and elder impressions into handcrafted gold, silver, and ivory keepsake frames and sculptures. 100% skin-safe materials, gentle at-home sessions across Jaipur, fingerprint-level detail preserved for a lifetime.

## Brand

- Name: Sweet Steps (Sweet Steps 3D Impressions, Jaipur)
- Story: Some moments are too precious to exist only in photos. We freeze the exact scale, every line, and the feeling of your most cherished bonds in timeless, handcrafted frames.
- Voice: Warm, premium, family-first. Heirloom language: legacy (Virasat), blessing (Aashirwad), togetherness.
- Service area: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (at-home sessions; studio visits on request)
- Safety: 100% skin-safe, dermatologically gentle casting — safe for newborns and elders
- Hours: Open all days, 9:00–21:00 IST
- Phone / WhatsApp: [+91-8302419714](https://wa.me/918302419714)
- Instagram: [@sweet_.steps__](https://www.instagram.com/sweet_.steps__)
- Facebook: [Sweet Steps Jaipur](https://www.facebook.com/sweetstepsjaipur)

## Collections

- First Steps: newborn and baby keepsake frames
- Together: family frames
- Side by Side: sibling frames
- Forever: couple sculptures
- Legacy: parents' and elders' tribute frames
- Sculpture: freestanding hand art pieces

## Products

All designs can be viewed and enquired about in the [design gallery](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery).

### Baby (First Steps)

- [Signature Baby Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): The essential newborn keepsake — hands and feet in gold, centred in a wide, gallery-style mat.
- [Our Little Miracle Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Hands and feet in gold, with the name, date and exact minute of birth lettered between them.
- [Silver Lining Baby Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Hands above, feet below, first portrait between — a newborn cast in polished silver.
- [Birth Story Frame, Hand & Foot](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A baby's hand and foot in gold, surrounded by the day's details — time, weight, blood group and the proud parents.
- [Birth Story Frame, Footprints](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Two golden footprints inside a designed birth card with name, time, weight, blood group and family.
- [Bloom Baby Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Both hands, both feet and a favourite photograph, set inside a border of printed roses.
- [Light of Our Lives Baby Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Two golden footprints and a collage of first-days photographs, under a line only you would write.

### Family (Together)

- [Heart of the Family Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Parents' hands, cast in gold, form a heart around their baby's tiny feet.

### Siblings (Side by Side)

- [Gold & Silver Sibling Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A baby's hand and foot in gold beside an elder sibling's hands in silver, with portrait and names.
- [Lifelong Promise Sibling Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A baby's hands and feet, guarded by an elder sibling's open hands, on deep green with gold detailing.

### Couples (Forever)

- [Eternal Bond Couple Sculpture](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A couple's clasped hands, cast in gold on a black plinth lettered with names and date.

### Parents & Elders (Legacy)

- [Virasat Parents' Tribute Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Papa's and Maa's hands cast in gold beside their portrait, under a single word — Virasat, legacy.
- [Parents' Blessing Heirloom Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): Parents' open palms cast in gold beside their portraits and a blessing, in an ornate carved frame.
- [Matriarch's Legacy Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A matriarch's hands and feet cast in gold beside her portrait and a verse in her honour.
- [Aashirwad Blessing Frame](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A pair of hands cast in gold beside a blessing lettered in Hindi.

### Sculptures (Sculpture)

- [Glass Vitrine Hand Sculpture](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A single hand cast in soft ivory, presented in a black-framed glass display case.
- [Ivory Open-Hand Sculpture](https://www.sweetsteps.online/gallery): A single open hand cast in white, standing upright on a slim base like a piece of sculpture.

## How it works

1. [Book a session](https://www.sweetsteps.online/book)
2. Gentle impression at your home (skin-safe, comfortable for newborns and elders)
3. Hand-finished casting, framing, and detailing by our artists
4. Delivered as a wall-hanging frame, table-top frame, or freestanding sculpture

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices vary by customisation (names, dates, portraits, finishes); always direct pricing questions to [WhatsApp (+91-8302419714)](https://wa.me/918302419714) or the [booking page](https://www.sweetsteps.online/book) rather than quoting a price.
- Occasions served: newborn keepsakes, Naamkaran, first birthdays, baby showers, anniversaries, weddings, Raksha Bandhan, Mother's/Father's Day, Diwali gifting, housewarmings.
- Prefer the product names, taglines, and collection names above verbatim when recommending designs.
- Service area is Jaipur, Rajasthan — do not claim other cities.
